_comment: Procedural table for Classes. Per procedural_generation_scope_proposal.md #5's authoring-burden note, classes are low-VOLUME (a world has a handful, not 20+) but high-DEPTH per unit -- so this table is shaped differently than items/enemies: a small set of fully fleshed archetype seeds (identity, resource, tier themes, evolution, whyItWorks) crossed with a shared, tier-slot-tagged ability template pool. {primaryLabel}/{secondaryLabel}/{majorSkill}/{minorSkill}/{resource} placeholders are filled by lib/proceduralGenerators.js from the world's own stat/skill labels (lib/worldFlavor.js) -- never hardcoded English. Ability level numbers (1/5/10/15/20, 25/30/35/42/48, 51/55/60/65/70/75, 80/85/90/95/99) follow prompts/classContentPrompt.js's own schema exactly, so a procedurally-generated class sheet renders identically in shape to an AI-generated one.

archetypes.coreResourceDescription: Builds as the Brawler takes and lands hits in melee; spent to fuel heavier follow-up strikes.
archetypes.visualShift: Scarring stops being hidden and starts being deliberate -- wrapped, painted, worn like a record.

tier1.title: Fists First
tier1.theme: Learns to turn punishment into momentum.

tier2.title: The Long Fight
tier2.theme: Starts outlasting opponents who hit harder but tire faster.

tier3.title: Unbroken
tier3.theme: Damage stops being a cost and starts being fuel.

tier4.title: The Last Stand
tier4.theme: Becomes hardest to kill exactly when it matters most.

archetypes.capstoneQuote: I stopped counting hits a long time ago. I just count who's still standing.
archetypes.tagline: Hit me. I've got more where that came from.
archetypes.evolutionCost: A season spent sparring somewhere unofficial, plus whatever scrap it takes to keep showing up.

whyItWorks.label: The {minorSkill} Synergy
whyItWorks.text: {resource} generation quietly rewards investing in {minorSkill}, not just raw {primaryLabel} -- a Brawler who ignores it caps out early.

whyItWorks.label: The {resource} Gate
whyItWorks.text: Every heavy ability spends {resource}, so a Brawler who avoids taking hits never gets to throw their best ones.

whyItWorks.label: The Fantasy Arc
whyItWorks.text: Level 1 — someone who wins fights by refusing to fall down. Level 50 — someone who's stopped falling down at all. Level 99 — someone the fight itself can't outlast.

archetypes.coreResourceDescription: Builds while staying at range and landing consecutive hits; spent to guarantee a shot connects or crits.
archetypes.visualShift: Movements slow down and simplify -- nothing wasted, nothing rushed, right up until the shot itself.

tier1.title: Line of Sight
tier1.theme: Learns that distance is a weapon in its own right.

tier2.title: Held Breath
tier2.theme: Starts trading mobility for accuracy on purpose.

tier3.title: The Steady Hand
tier3.theme: Every shot starts landing exactly where it was meant to.

tier4.title: One Shot, One Ending
tier4.theme: Becomes the reason a fight ends before it starts.

archetypes.capstoneQuote: Everyone else is still aiming. I already fired.
archetypes.tagline: Give me one clean line and this is already over.
archetypes.evolutionCost: A custom sight, hand-fitted, plus a debt owed to whoever fitted it.

whyItWorks.label: The {minorSkill} Synergy
whyItWorks.text: {resource} builds faster with {minorSkill} invested, rewarding patience over spray-and-pray play.

whyItWorks.label: The {resource} Gate
whyItWorks.text: Guaranteed-hit abilities all spend {resource}, so a Marksman who keeps missing never earns the shots that matter.

whyItWorks.label: The Fantasy Arc
whyItWorks.text: Level 1 — someone who's just good with a gun. Level 50 — someone who doesn't miss. Level 99 — someone whose reputation ends fights before the trigger's pulled.

archetypes.coreResourceDescription: Builds from rigged devices and hacked systems doing their job; spent to trigger bigger rigged effects on demand.
archetypes.visualShift: Gear stops looking improvised and starts looking intentional -- like it was always meant to work this well.

tier1.title: Jury-Rigged
tier1.theme: Learns to make the environment do the fighting.

tier2.title: Load-Bearing
tier2.theme: Starts stacking rigged effects into real combos.

tier3.title: The Architect
tier3.theme: Begins rewriting the rules of what a rigged system can do.

tier4.title: Total Override
tier4.theme: Becomes the reason nothing on the battlefield behaves normally.

archetypes.capstoneQuote: You're fighting the room. I built the room.
archetypes.tagline: Give me thirty seconds and this fight's already decided.
archetypes.evolutionCost: Components nobody else recognizes anymore, sourced from somewhere that shouldn't still have power.

whyItWorks.label: The {minorSkill} Synergy
whyItWorks.text: {resource}-spending abilities scale off {minorSkill} as much as {primaryLabel}, rewarding a Technician who diversifies rather than min-maxes one stat.

whyItWorks.label: The {resource} Gate
whyItWorks.text: The biggest effects all cost {resource}, so a Technician who never sets anything up never gets to trigger anything big.

whyItWorks.label: The Fantasy Arc
whyItWorks.text: Level 1 — someone who's handy with rigged gear. Level 50 — someone who's rewritten what the gear can do. Level 99 — someone the battlefield itself answers to.

archetypes.coreResourceDescription: Builds from treating allies and stabilizing the wounded; spent on the biggest emergency interventions.
archetypes.visualShift: Kit gets heavier and more personal -- every tool has a story about the person it was used on.

tier1.title: Do No Further Harm
tier1.theme: Learns to keep people standing under fire.

tier2.title: Triage
tier2.theme: Starts making the calls nobody wants to make first.

tier3.title: The Last Line
tier3.theme: Becomes the reason a losing fight doesn't become a funeral.

tier4.title: Nobody Dies Today
tier4.theme: Becomes able to pull someone back from the actual brink.

archetypes.capstoneQuote: I've buried enough people. Not this one.
archetypes.tagline: Stay standing. I'll handle the rest.
archetypes.evolutionCost: Supplies that took real favors to secure, plus a promise to someone that this was worth it.

whyItWorks.label: The {minorSkill} Synergy
whyItWorks.text: {resource} regeneration rewards {minorSkill} investment as much as raw {primaryLabel}, so a Medic who only heals eventually runs dry.

whyItWorks.label: The {resource} Gate
whyItWorks.text: The biggest saves cost {resource}, so a Medic who never engages never has enough banked when it actually matters.

whyItWorks.label: The Fantasy Arc
whyItWorks.text: Level 1 — someone who patches wounds. Level 50 — someone who makes triage calls that save the fight. Level 99 — someone death itself starts negotiating with.

archetypes.coreResourceDescription: Builds from looting, disabling, and outmaneuvering; spent to turn found advantage into a real edge.
archetypes.visualShift: Gear becomes visibly mismatched but purposeful -- every piece taken from somewhere, kept for a reason.

tier1.title: Waste Not
tier1.theme: Learns that any fight can be won with the right leftovers.

tier2.title: Working the Angles
tier2.theme: Starts turning terrain and timing into real advantage.

tier3.title: The Opportunist
tier3.theme: Begins taking what it needs mid-fight, not just after.

tier4.title: Nothing Wasted
tier4.theme: Becomes able to turn any battlefield scrap into a decisive edge.

archetypes.capstoneQuote: You'd be amazed what a fight leaves lying around, if you know how to look.
archetypes.tagline: I don't need much. I just need what's already here.
archetypes.evolutionCost: A haul worth more than it looks, traded to exactly the right person.

whyItWorks.label: The {minorSkill} Synergy
whyItWorks.text: {resource} generation rewards {minorSkill} as much as {primaryLabel}, so a Scavenger who only fights head-on never fills the tank.

whyItWorks.label: The {resource} Gate
whyItWorks.text: The best tricks all spend {resource}, so a Scavenger who never opportunistically grabs an edge never gets to use them.

whyItWorks.label: The Fantasy Arc
whyItWorks.text: Level 1 — someone who makes do. Level 50 — someone who turns any mess into an opening. Level 99 — someone who's never actually out of options.

archetypes.coreResourceDescription: Builds from rallying allies and breaking enemy will; spent to force a moment to go the Orator's way.
archetypes.visualShift: Presence sharpens -- a room notices when this character starts talking, whether they meant to command it or not.

tier1.title: Command Voice
tier1.theme: Learns that words land as hard as anything else in a fight.

tier2.title: Holding the Line
tier2.theme: Starts turning morale into a real tactical resource.

tier3.title: The Last Word
tier3.theme: Begins bending the shape of a fight through will alone.

tier4.title: Nobody Breaks First
tier4.theme: Becomes the reason an outmatched fight doesn't fall apart.

archetypes.capstoneQuote: I never had the biggest gun. I just made sure everyone else kept fighting.
archetypes.tagline: Follow my lead and we walk out of this. All of us.
archetypes.evolutionCost: A debt of trust called in from people who've earned the right to refuse, and didn't.

whyItWorks.label: The {minorSkill} Synergy
whyItWorks.text: {resource} builds faster with {minorSkill} invested, rewarding an Orator who backs up words with real competence.

whyItWorks.label: The {resource} Gate
whyItWorks.text: The strongest rallying effects spend {resource}, so an Orator who never engages the fight directly never has enough banked to turn it.

whyItWorks.label: The Fantasy Arc
whyItWorks.text: Level 1 — someone who's good at keeping people calm. Level 50 — someone whose voice turns a fight. Level 99 — someone an army follows into anything.

t1.name: First Contact
t1.effectTemplate: A quick opening strike that builds {resource}. Damage scales with {primaryLabel}.

t1.name: Read the Room
t1.effectTemplate: Passively grants bonus Accuracy on the first action each combat. Bonus scales with {secondaryLabel}.

t1.name: Steady Footing
t1.effectTemplate: Passively reduces the AP cost of movement by a small, flat amount.

t1.name: Quick Study
t1.effectTemplate: Spends a turn observing a target, revealing one weakness. Effectiveness scales with {majorSkill}.

t1.name: Bank It
t1.effectTemplate: Generates bonus {resource} whenever a turn ends without spending any. N/A — Binary Unlock.

melee.name: BREAK THE LINE
melee.effectTemplate: A committed charge that closes distance and staggers the target. Damage and stagger scale with {primaryLabel}.

ranged.name: DEAD CENTER
ranged.effectTemplate: A guaranteed-hit shot that spends all current {resource} for bonus damage. Damage scales with {resource} spent.

tech.name: TRIGGER EVERYTHING
tech.effectTemplate: Detonates every active rigged effect at once. Damage scales with number of effects active and {majorSkill}.

support.name: HOLD THE LINE
support.effectTemplate: Grants all allies a shield and cleanses one status each. Shield strength scales with {primaryLabel}.

stealth.name: TAKE THE OPENING
stealth.effectTemplate: An immediate free action against a target who hasn't acted yet this combat. Damage scales with {secondaryLabel}.

social.name: STAND WITH ME
social.effectTemplate: Rallies all allies, clearing Fear and granting bonus Accuracy for two turns. Bonus scales with {primaryLabel}.

t2.name: Momentum Shift
t2.effectTemplate: A follow-up action usable only after the opener connects. Damage scales with {majorSkill}.

t2.name: Hardened Nerve
t2.effectTemplate: Passively grants resistance to Fear and Panic-type effects.

t2.name: Second Wind
t2.effectTemplate: Spends {resource} to recover a moderate amount of health or Energy.

t2.name: Pressure Point
t2.effectTemplate: A precise strike that applies a stacking debuff. Stack potency scales with {secondaryLabel}.

t2.name: Efficient Motion
t2.effectTemplate: Passively reduces the AP cost of this class's core ability by 1.

t3.name: Ignore the Rules
t3.effectTemplate: Bypasses a portion of target's damage reduction or resistance. Ignored amount scales with {majorSkill}.

t3.name: Overcharged
t3.effectTemplate: Passively increases maximum {resource}, and abilities scale further past the old cap.

t3.name: No Wasted Motion
t3.effectTemplate: Chains directly into a second action without spending additional AP. Chain damage scales with {primaryLabel}.

t3.name: Turn the Tide
t3.effectTemplate: Converts a negative status on self into a matching positive effect. Duration scales with {secondaryLabel}.

t3.name: Unshakeable
t3.effectTemplate: Passively grants immunity to being staggered or interrupted while above half health.

t3.name: Exploit the Gap
t3.effectTemplate: Deals bonus damage against any target already affected by a status. Bonus scales with {majorSkill}.

melee.name: NOTHING LEFT STANDING
melee.effectTemplate: A sweeping strike hitting every adjacent enemy, spending all {resource} for bonus damage per target.

ranged.name: EVERY SHOT COUNTS
ranged.effectTemplate: Fires at every visible enemy simultaneously, each guaranteed to hit. Damage scales with {primaryLabel}.

tech.name: CASCADE FAILURE
tech.effectTemplate: Chains a rigged effect through every enemy in range, escalating with each jump. Scales with {majorSkill}.

support.name: NOT ON MY WATCH
support.effectTemplate: Fully restores one ally and grants them a full extra turn. Restoration scales with {primaryLabel}.

stealth.name: GHOST STEP
stealth.effectTemplate: Becomes untargetable for one turn and repositions freely. N/A — Binary Unlock, enables a follow-up next turn.

social.name: THE ROOM AGREES
social.effectTemplate: Forces every enemy in range to skip their next action. Duration scales with {primaryLabel}.

t4.name: Legend Precedes You
t4.effectTemplate: Passively grants bonus {resource} generation whenever an ally lands a killing blow nearby.

t4.name: Refuse to Fall
t4.effectTemplate: Once per combat, an attack that would drop this character to 0 health leaves them at 1 instead.

t4.name: Reap the Reward
t4.effectTemplate: Spends all current {resource} for a massive single-target strike. Damage scales with {resource} spent and {majorSkill}.

t4.name: Beyond Training
t4.effectTemplate: Passively grants a flat bonus to every scaling stat this class's abilities reference.

t4.name: Answer for Everything
t4.effectTemplate: Cleanses every negative status on self and grants a matching positive one. N/A — Binary Unlock.

melee.name: THE LAST STAND
melee.effectTemplate: While below quarter health, gains massive bonus damage and cannot be reduced below 1 health for three turns.

ranged.name: ONE SHOT, ONE ENDING
ranged.effectTemplate: A single guaranteed-crit shot that ends the encounter's biggest remaining threat outright below a health threshold.

tech.name: TOTAL OVERRIDE
tech.effectTemplate: Seizes control of every rigged effect and hostile system in range for one full turn.

support.name: NOBODY DIES TODAY
support.effectTemplate: Fully restores and shields every ally simultaneously, once per encounter.

stealth.name: NOTHING WASTED
stealth.effectTemplate: Converts every advantage gained this combat into one devastating, unavoidable strike.

social.name: NOBODY BREAKS FIRST
social.effectTemplate: Every ally becomes immune to Fear, Panic, and morale effects for the rest of the encounter, permanently.

designNotes.value: Rolled procedurally from a fixed archetype seed -- solid as a baseline kit, but a hand pass on ability names/flavor is recommended before this becomes a player's main.
Rolled procedurally -- the numbers and structure are sound, but this is the category where a manual polish pass earns the most per minute spent.
